witness.definition: G(n) = (smallest prime strictly greater than n) - n, exact integer arithmetic

verifier_source:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Standalone fail-closed verifier for L1 finite core (route R008).
# Exact integer arithmetic only. No imports, no I/O, no network, no writes,
# no floats, no prints. Witness is embedded as literals. Deterministic.
# PASS = script terminates normally (exit 0). FAIL = AssertionError (nonzero).

WITNESS_GAP_TABLE = {
    2: 1, 3: 2, 4: 1, 5: 2, 6: 1, 7: 4, 8: 3, 9: 2, 10: 1,
    11: 2, 12: 1, 13: 4, 14: 3, 15: 2, 16: 1, 17: 2, 18: 1,
    19: 4, 20: 3, 21: 2, 22: 1, 23: 6, 24: 5, 25: 4, 26: 3,
    27: 2, 28: 1, 29: 2, 30: 1, 31: 6, 32: 5, 33: 4, 34: 3,
    35: 2, 36: 1, 37: 4, 38: 3, 39: 2, 40: 1
}
WITNESS_MIN_G = 1
WITNESS_MAX_G = 6
WITNESS_ARGMAX = [23, 31]

def is_prime(m):
    if m < 2:
        return False
    d = 2
    while d * d <= m:
        if m % d == 0:
            return False
        d += 1
    return True

def next_prime(n):
    m = n + 1
    while not is_prime(m):
        m += 1
    return m

def verify():
    # Recompute G(n) exactly and compare entry by entry against witness.
    for n in range(2, 41):
        assert WITNESS_GAP_TABLE[n] == next_prime(n) - n
    vals = [next_prime(n) - n for n in range(2, 41)]
    mn = min(vals)
    mx = max(vals)
    argmax = [n for n in range(2, 41) if next_prime(n) - n == mx]
    assert mn == WITNESS_MIN_G
    assert mx == WITNESS_MAX_G
    assert argmax == WITNESS_ARGMAX
    assert WITNESS_MIN_G <= WITNESS_MAX_G
    assert WITNESS_ARGMAX == [23, 31]

verify()

This does NOT certify the 0.4650 infimum claim or any asymptotic/transference content of L1; those remain open on the route.
